notes:
Checked on the fake backend only (gate run 2): PASS, evidence contract_checked. No DEVIATION FROM THE CARD; the card's family-config GymnasiumDriver is used as-is with native ravens.environments.environment:Environment (entry symbols confirmed at environment.py:42 and :463). The upstream Environment was never imported or run: its gym/pybullet/numpy stack and asset tree are not in the gate, and package code never imports the clone. No sim path was run: Ravens registers no Gym environment and needs assets_root plus a task object, so env_id is unset and GymnasiumDriver.open_native's gym.make path is not used. The fake is a pure-Python stand-in for the public Environment surface (reset/step/seed/close and the same Dict/Tuple/Box action and observation space structure); it does not run PyBullet, models no contacts, actuator dynamics, task rewards or terminal conditions, and returns placeholder RGB-D arrays smaller than the upstream RealSenseD415 480 by 640 images; the fidelity gaps disclose all of this and that the fake was not compared with an upstream run. Determinism is declared none because Environment.seed() only seeds the camera-noise generator (environment.py:175-177) and the default camera configuration has noise disabled (cameras.py:41-73), while task resets draw from the global numpy RNG; the fake can repeat for a seed, but that is test data, not a device guarantee. Limits: none declared; the upstream position and rotation boxes (environment.py:89-103) are not enforced because the gymnasium bridge derives no per-element limits inside a Tuple pose action (a simulation-only residual, listed in the fidelity gaps). There are no operator_required bounds, so site-limits.example.json is absent. No hardware backend exists and no hardware run is claimed; the package is model-authored and unreviewed, and the e-stop is the runtime's software latch. Warnings from the last gate run: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed is stored in the bridge for the next reset and makes no native call); G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the bridge-derived integer inputs (ticks, reset seed, seed); G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because no actuating capability carries a limit (the Tuple residual above), so the suite awarded CL2 and every other CL3 test passed. There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings.
